title: feat(record-page): an empty field you can edit reads 「设置{字段名}」 and one click fills it; an editable value offers the copy icon
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
Fixes #36292

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVF7sWPNE4HmjkgyaVxQYif)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRaJbQ4vqdv4J5peqA

Part of epic #35590 (record page redo). Claim 7075947584 (`Premise: corrected`); binding linked ruling: #36147 record 7066516044 (option A), shipped by #36234.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The claim's line reads `Clause-②: no (expected …)` with the instruction to amend it to `yes (widening)` if a key is added: one key is added, `detail.setField`, in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack. No prop, export or schema key is removed or narrowed.

## 维护者速读

- 记录页字段区（右侧预览、手机「详情」、整页）里可以编辑的空字段，从「—」变成浅色的「设置某某」，点一下直接进编辑；可编辑的值鼠标移上去右边也有复制图标。
- 属于记录页重做专题，按维护者「立」的第 4 条（单击进编辑、空字段可点）补齐还没做的部分。
- 出错时最多是空字段显示的字或复制图标位置不对，不影响保存的数据；撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 无

## What changes

Measured on `origin/main` b3bcfefc before writing anything (the card's items, one by one, on the synthesized record page's field area, which is `DetailSection`'s frameless face in all of the side preview, the phone 「详情」 tab, the pinned left column and a full page alone):

| Card item | On main before this PR | This PR |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 1. Single click enters edit | **Already shipped** by #36234: the row's `onClick` on the frameless face calls `onEnterInlineEdit` (guarded by `clickBelongsElsewhere`) | unchanged |
| 2a. Links, phone, email, chips: a click on the text opens it, the rest of the value edits | **Already shipped** by #36234: `clickBelongsElsewhere` hands a click on an `a`, a button or a `role=link` to that element | unchanged |
| 2b. Hover copy icon on any value | **Half**: read-only values only. The button block was `canInlineEditField ? pencil : copyOffered ? copy : null`, so an editable value had no copy icon | an editable value on the frameless face also draws the copy button (hover / keyboard focus, `pointer-coarse:hidden` per ruling item 1); the keyboard-only pencil stays beside it |
| 3. Empty editable value reads 「设置某某」, one click edits | **Missing**: every empty value drew the shared `EmptyValue` dash | an empty value with `canInlineEditField` on the frameless face reads `t('detail.setField', { field })` in `text-muted-foreground/70`; the row's existing click enters edit. Read-only, no write grant, record not inline-editable: the dash, unchanged |
| 4. "Show N empty fields" fold unchanged; shown, empty rows read 「设置某某」 | fold **already shipped** by #36234 (`EmptyFieldsRow`) | shown rows now read the placeholder |
| 5. Full page, side preview, phone alike | the three places are the one frameless face (`DefaultRecordPageContext`) | follows from the one face |

- **Authored record pages** (and every other `DetailView`) keep their faces, as #36234 left them: double-click and the pencil, and the dash on an empty value. A "set" placeholder there would invite a single click that does nothing. Raised as an open question in the report, not built.
- i18n: `detail.setField` in all eleven packs (en `Set {{field}}`, zh-Hans `设置{{field}}`, zh-Hant `設定{{field}}`, ja `{{field}}を設定`, ko `{{field}} 설정`, de `{{field}} festlegen`, fr `Définir {{field}}`, es `Establecer {{field}}`, pt-BR `Definir {{field}}`, ru `Указать «{{field}}»`, ar `تعيين {{field}}`).
- Changeset `.changeset/36292-record-field-set-placeholder.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/i18n`: patch).

Files to read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, the `displayValue` closure's new first branch (`isEmpty && frameless && canInlineEditField`), where the placeholder replaces the dash.
2. Same file, the button block at the end of the read row: the pencil and the copy button are now siblings, the copy one gated `copyOffered && (!canInlineEditField || frameless)`.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.fieldList-36147.test.tsx`, the two new top-level `describe` blocks.

## Tests

New pins in the existing field-list harness (two top-level `describe`s, objectstack#36292):

- an empty editable value reads `Set Note` / `Set Phone` and a click on it enters edit with `note`;
- CONTROL: a non-empty value reads as before;
- CONTROL: a read-only field keeps the `No value` placeholder and its click does not enter edit;
- CONTROL: a record that is not inline-editable keeps the placeholder on every empty row;
- CONTROL: a field the caller may not write (a real `MePermissionsProvider` envelope, `editable: false`) keeps the placeholder;
- CONTROL: off the field face (the section's own empty-fields toggle opened, so the row is on screen) the placeholder is the dash;
- through a real `I18nProvider` in `zh-CN` the placeholder reads `设置备注`;
- the copy button sits beside an editable value, hidden at rest, revealed on hover / focus, `pointer-coarse:hidden`, copies `Atlas deal` and does not enter edit; CONTROL: an empty editable value has none; CONTROL: off the field face an editable row keeps the pencil alone.

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots the card asks for, taken on head `2c35661f` in a live CRM example app (`examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --fresh`) with the Console dev server built from that head; Chromium 1440x900 at deviceScaleFactor 2, UI language zh-CN, the lead "Marie Curie" after 「显示 2 个空字段」. Hosted on the side branch `claude/issue-36292-evidence` (never merged), not on this branch. No read-only empty field is cheaply reachable on this record (every empty body field is editable for the admin), so the 「—」 control rests on the jsdom pins above.

  Full record page, empty editable fields read 「设置分配给」 / 「设置转化商机」:

  ![Full page: empty fields read 设置分配给 and 设置转化商机](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/c515f32858fa6e08e209d0c3fbf913bfd3ab8c3f/evidence/36292/full-empty-set.png?raw=true)

  Full record page, after one click on 「设置转化商机」 (the inline edit session opens):

  ![Full page: edit after one click](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/c515f32858fa6e08e209d0c3fbf913bfd3ab8c3f/evidence/36292/full-edit-after-click.png?raw=true)

  Side preview, the same two placeholders:

  ![Side preview: empty fields read 设置分配给 and 设置转化商机](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/c515f32858fa6e08e209d0c3fbf913bfd3ab8c3f/evidence/36292/preview-empty-set.png?raw=true)

  Side preview, after one click on 「设置转化商机」:

  ![Side preview: edit after one click](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/c515f32858fa6e08e209d0c3fbf913bfd3ab8c3f/evidence/36292/preview-edit-after-click.png?raw=true)
- Not re-verified in a browser: Enter / click-away saves and Esc cancels; those are the existing inline-edit session's keys, untouched here.
- The card's 没有核对的 items (approval-locked records; tap-vs-scroll on a phone) are unchanged by this PR: a locked record is not inline-editable, so its empty fields keep the dash.

## Verification

Two minutes: on a default record page (HotCRM 线索, or any object without an authored record page) open the side preview, click 「显示 N 个空字段」. Expected: each empty field you can edit reads light 「设置字段名」; one click opens its editor. A read-only empty field still reads 「—」. Hover a filled editable value: a copy icon appears at its right, and clicking it copies without entering edit.
